name: twelvefold-institute
//: Two known moderate transitive dev-only vulnerabilities are currently accepted: (1) esbuild via drizzle-kit/@esbuild-kit/* — tracked in drizzle-orm#5481, PR #5689 open. Only exploitable while drizzle-kit dev commands are running. Zero production impact. (2) postcss via next — build-time only. Zero production runtime exposure. Both fixes would require breaking downgrades (drizzle-kit or next@9.3.3). Reassess when drizzle-kit merges a tsx-based replacement or when Next 15.6+ ships with updated postcss.
